# perch-widgets

The community widget registry for **[Perch](https://github.com/mayukh4/perch)**,
the quiet desk instrument for a Raspberry Pi.

Your widget lives in **your** repo, under your name, with your license. This
repo is a list of pointers: one JSON file per widget, validated by CI, with
freshness checked weekly so the list never quietly rots.

## Using a widget

Perch compiles widgets in — there is no plugin loader, which is also why a
widget cannot smuggle anything past you: you can read every line you install.

```bash
cd perch
git clone https://github.com/AUTHOR/WIDGET-REPO /tmp/w &&
  cp -r /tmp/w/widget widgets/THEIR-ID
npm run registry && npm run typecheck && npm run build
```

Then it appears in your console's palette like any other widget. Read what
you just copied — it runs with Perch's privileges, and listing here is not a
security review (see [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md)).

## Submitting yours

One JSON file, one PR, checks run by CI, and a human glance at the end —
the whole path is in **[SUBMITTING.md](SUBMITTING.md)**. Start from the
**[widget template](https://github.com/mayukh4/perch-widget-template)**,
which arrives with the manifest, the layout and the validation workflow
already in place.

## How the list stays honest

- `index.json` is **generated** from `widgets/*.json` by CI — never edited
  by hand.
- A weekly job checks every listed repo. Gone or archived → moved to
  `removed.json` (with the reason). No commits in 18 months → marked
  `stale`, which Perch's tooling can show.
- Updates pin a release tag and the version must increase — an author
  cannot silently swap what a listing points at.
